nodes.title: Local-first memory
nodes.excerpt: Canonical knowledge remains inspectable Markdown. Indexes and visualization stay derived and rebuildable.

nodes.title: Graph export contract
nodes.excerpt: The graph index contains typed source, relation, target triples. Its edges are a retrieval aid, not authority.

nodes.title: Read-only review
nodes.excerpt: Inspect the export and source hash before acting. Never write from the visualization.

nodes.title: Remote filesystem latency
nodes.excerpt: Observed slow source reads suggest an I/O lead, not proof of retrieval algorithm cost.

nodes.title: No second memory store
nodes.excerpt: A viewer consumes the existing export and does not own memory state.

nodes.title: Local graph association
nodes.excerpt: Synthetic derived association; it cannot amplify source authority.

nodes.title: Graph interface discussion
nodes.excerpt: Explored a browser-based visualization while retaining Markdown and review workflows.

nodes.title: Visualizer review candidate
nodes.excerpt: A candidate idea stays quarantined from canonical claims until the established review flow accepts it.
